info.title: MFB Digital Lending Platform
info.description:
Lending platform API. Customer, KYC, and staff authentication use one contract for React and Flutter clients: send the access token as Authorization: Bearer, and send the refresh token in the JSON body. There is no separate mobile flow. Optional header X-Client-Channel is WEB or MOBILE. Access tokens are short-lived. Refresh tokens rotate on every use, and reuse of a rotated token revokes the session family. Customer identity numbers are encrypted at rest and masked in responses. Loan products are versioned. A new version never rewrites a previous version, and a booked loan keeps the version it was opened on. Product activation uses maker-checker: the administrator who submitted a version cannot approve or activate it. Credit assessments keep the scoring model version, policy version, and calculation inputs that produced the decision. A credit score cannot override a compliance hold or a mandatory policy failure. Policy exceptions need a second officer. Credit bureau calls go through a provider port. This API does not publish a bureau vendor URL. Collateral is approved security only after ownership, documents, legal status, insurance, and encumbrance checks, and an approved valuation. Pledges cannot exceed the approved eligible value. Release needs a different authorised officer and a settled or discharged facility. Guarantor identity numbers are encrypted. A guarantor is not approved security until consent, verification, a guarantee agreement, and acceptance by a second officer are on record. Loan approval uses a versioned matrix. Amount, product, segment, branch, risk, collateral, security, and exception type select the stages. Approval limits are stored as delegations, and a user cannot approve a request they made, an application they originated, or an amount above that delegation. An approval decision is immutable. A later change to the application amount, revision, or credit result supersedes it. Automated approval runs only after credit assessment when the product, matrix, eligibility, and compliance gates all allow it. A loan offer can be generated only after final approval. Interest, instalments, fees, and the repayment schedule come from the loan calculation engine and the product version pinned to the application. A material change creates a new offer version and requires a fresh acceptance. The agreement PDF checksum is retained and checked on download. Customer acceptance is an electronic record of a verified KYC identity. It is not a qualified digital signature unless an approved signature provider is configured and legally approved. Core banking calls go through a provider-neutral adapter. The mock provider is the default and does not call a bank. The HTTP provider sends this platform's transport document only to paths supplied in configuration. A financial timeout remains UNKNOWN until enquiry resolves it, and that instruction is not retried. Webhooks use HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body and reject stale timestamps. A loan account becomes active only after core banking confirms disbursement. Interest is recognised from the contractual schedule with BigDecimal. Daily pieces, including 29 February, add back to the contractual instalment interest. A repayment, settlement, or reversal changes the loan balance only after the core banking adapter confirms the cash movement. Repayments are idempotent. Posted journals cannot be edited or deleted; a correction is a reversal plus a replacement. Every posted journal balances by currency. Interest adjustments stay in draft until a different officer approves them. Collections delinquency uses the current approved repayment schedule and repayment allocations whose repayment status is POSTED. An instalment due on the as-of date is not past due. Portfolio at Risk divides the outstanding principal of included loans whose days past due meet the threshold by the outstanding principal of ACTIVE and OVERDUE loans with principal still outstanding. PAR 30, PAR 60, and PAR 90 use thresholds of 30, 60, and 90 days, and a loan in PAR 90 is also in PAR 60 and PAR 30. Pending activation, closed, and zero-principal loans are outside the denominator. Collection messages use approved templates and do not carry phone numbers, email addresses, or identity numbers. Restructuring needs a documented justification and a different authorised officer. Approval keeps the previous schedule, writes a new schedule version, and does not clear accrued interest, fees, penalties, or stored delinquency history. Management reports aggregate in SQL. Customer dashboards return only the authenticated customer's own loans, applications, repayments, and statement. Staff results stay inside assigned branches unless the role is unrestricted. Days past due for management PAR use the current schedule and POSTED allocations, and an instalment due on the as-of date is not past due. Disbursements, repayment collections, interest income, and fee income are posted journal totals. Reconciliation compares those journals with the loan subledger, interest accruals, fee charges, and confirmed recoveries. Write-off expense is general-ledger account 5100. An uncollectible collection closure is an operational count, not a journal. Large extracts stream to CSV, Excel, or PDF asynchronously, expire, and can be downloaded only by the requester with the export token. Report requests and downloads are audited. Identity numbers, phone numbers, email addresses, and account numbers are not selected. Customer names on staff extracts are masked. View access does not grant export access. Notifications use versioned templates for SMS, email, push, and in-app delivery. Phone numbers, email addresses, and verification codes are not stored on the notification. Failed deliveries retry with backoff and then become dead letters. Duplicate events are ignored. Customers can set channel preferences, except verification codes, which stay on. Push delivery needs a device token; without one the message is skipped. Audit records are append-only and sealed with a hash chain. Passwords, tokens, and raw BVN or NIN values are removed before they are written. Sanctions, PEP, and AML matches open a compliance case. A potential sanctions match is not cleared unless an officer has recorded an investigation note and a different reviewer decides. Screening a clear result does not close an open sanctions case. Complaints keep a response history and an SLA. A breach escalates the case and keeps the earlier notes. Sensitive system configuration, integration settings, and sensitive feature flags stay pending until a different administrator approves them. Secrets stay in the environment, not in configuration values. 
Errors use the same envelope: success=false, code, message, errors, correlationId, timestamp, and path.

This file is the importable contract for Postman and typed clients. It is exported from the springdoc v1 group and then annotated with the error envelope, a base URL variable, and representative examples. Monetary fields remain JSON numbers, which is the implemented Jackson contract.

tags.name: Loan approvals
tags.description: Multi-stage loan approval. The active matrix version selects the stages from the amount, product, segment, branch, risk rating, collateral position, security classification, and exception type. Limits are delegated records, not code. The requester, the originating user, and the analyst who recommended the credit decision cannot decide the same request. Send the version from the latest read. A conflicting decision returns 409. Reading an approval applies expiry and supersedes it when the application amount, revision, or credit result has changed. A committee stage stays open until the configured quorum of distinct approvals is reached. One rejection or return closes it.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: In-app notification history. Delivery attempts do not store phone numbers, email addresses, or verification codes.

tags.name: Approval configuration
tags.description: Approval matrices and delegated limits. A draft version can be edited. Activate publishes it and leaves the previous version readable. Match criteria and stage ceilings belong to the version, so a draft does not change approvals already in flight. Delegated limits are the only approval authority. A user with no active delegation cannot approve.

tags.name: Credit scoring policy
tags.description: Scoring models and assessment rules. A published model version keeps its weights, risk categories, thresholds, and policy version. Activate a new draft to change later assessments. Component weights must sum to 1. Rules carry the threshold and whether an approved exception may waive them. Compliance holds cannot be waived.

tags.name: System configuration
tags.description: Platform configuration. Sensitive and integration changes stay pending until a different administrator approves them. Secret values stay in the environment.

tags.name: Core banking webhooks
tags.description: Accepts a platform webhook contract. The body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + '.' + raw body. Send X-Core-Banking-Message-Id, X-Core-Banking-Timestamp as epoch seconds, and X-Core-Banking-Signature as hex. Replays outside the configured window are rejected. A repeated message id is acknowledged and not applied again. This contract is not a core banking vendor schema.

tags.name: Core banking integration
tags.description: Operational access to the core banking adapter. These endpoints do not call a vendor URL unless the HTTP provider and a path for that operation have been configured. The mock provider never posts to a bank. A financial timeout stays UNKNOWN until enquiry resolves it. Uncertain instructions are not retried.

tags.name: Loan application queue
tags.description: Staff queue and controlled status transitions. Supports pagination, filtering, and sorting.

tags.name: Customer authentication
tags.description: Shared by React and Flutter. Clients send Authorization: Bearer for protected calls and the refresh token in JSON. The signed-in customer is always taken from the access token, so one customer cannot request another customer's identity.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Database-backed roles. System roles keep their permission and branch rules.

tags.name: Credit assessments
tags.description: Credit assessment for an existing loan application. Inputs captured here stay fixed. Each evaluation appends a result that keeps the scoring model version, policy version, and calculation inputs and outputs. Decisions are AUTO_APPROVE, REFER, AUTO_REJECT, PENDING_DATA, or COMPLIANCE_HOLD. A score never overrides a compliance hold or a mandatory policy failure. An analyst approval that would change the decision opens a policy exception. A different officer approves it by sending exceptionId. Bureau checks use the configured provider port and do not call a vendor URL from this API.

tags.name: Loan applications
tags.description: Loan origination for individual and SME customers. React and Flutter use the same endpoints. Send Authorization: Bearer and optional X-Client-Channel WEB or MOBILE. Save a draft at each step, upload the product's required documents, then submit. A submitted application stays locked until staff return it for correction. Customers can read only their own applications.

tags.name: Branches
tags.description: Branch administration.

tags.name: User administration
tags.description: Staff and customer account administration. Results are limited to the caller's branches unless the caller has unrestricted branch access.

tags.name: Complaints
tags.description: Customer complaints, assignment, SLA escalation, and resolution history.

tags.name: Feature flags
tags.description: Operational feature flags. Sensitive flag changes require a second administrator.

tags.name: Loan offers
tags.description: Issues a loan offer from a finally approved application. Instalments, interest, fees, and taxes come from the loan calculation engine and the product version pinned to the application. A material change creates a new offer version and a new agreement; the previous agreement stays readable. Customer acceptance is an electronic record tied to a verified KYC identity. It is not a qualified digital signature unless an approved signature provider is configured and the institution has the required legal approval. The agreement PDF checksum is stored and checked on every download.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Database-backed permissions enforced on administration and, later, lending operations.

tags.name: Credit assessment queue
tags.description: Work queue for referred, pending-data, compliance-hold, and newly opened assessments assigned to the officer or still unassigned.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit trail. Passwords, tokens, and raw identity numbers are not stored.

tags.name: Business calendars
tags.description: Calendars, weekends, and public holidays.

tags.name: Collateral
tags.description: Security register for land, property, vehicles, equipment, machinery, inventory, fixed deposits, receivables, and other approved collateral. Eligible lending value is calculated from market value, forced sale value, and the policy lending ratio, then kept on the approved valuation. Only a collateral officer can verify or approve collateral. The officer who submitted a valuation cannot approve it. Documents stay in private storage and are not returned as public URLs.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Operational health for notifications, compliance, complaints, and pending approvals.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Platform foundation endpoints

tags.name: Staff authentication
tags.description: Staff sign-in uses the same token format as customer sign-in. Privileged roles must complete MFA before an access token is issued. React and Flutter clients share this contract.

tags.name: Loan security
tags.description: Links approved collateral and guarantors to a loan application. Shared security is allowed only when every active pledge is marked as shared, and the total pledged amount cannot exceed eligible collateral value. A linked guarantor remains unapproved security until verification and guarantee acceptance are complete.

tags.name: Guarantors
tags.description: Guarantor identity, employment, income, obligations, consent, and guarantee acceptance. BVN and NIN are encrypted and returned only in masked form. A guarantor is not approved security until consent, verification, a guarantee agreement, and acceptance by a different officer are complete.

tags.name: Compliance
tags.description: Sanctions, PEP, and AML review. A potential sanctions match stays open until an officer records an investigation note and a reviewer decides.

tags.name: Notification templates
tags.description: Versioned templates for SMS, email, push, and in-app notifications.

tags.name: Loan agreement templates
tags.description: Configurable agreement text. A change publishes a new version and leaves the previous text in place. Templates should be legally reviewed before they are used for customer acceptance.

tags.name: Loan offers
tags.description: Offers belonging to the signed-in customer.

tags.name: Notification preferences
tags.description: Customer channel preferences. Verification codes cannot be disabled.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customer onboarding, profiles, documents, and KYC. Web and mobile clients use the same endpoints. Identity numbers are stored encrypted and returned masked.

tags.name: Loan products
tags.description: Configurable personal and SME lending products. Versions are immutable after they leave draft, so a booked loan keeps the terms it was opened on. Approval and activation use maker-checker.

The PAR denominator is the outstanding principal of loan accounts in ACTIVE or OVERDUE status whose outstanding principal is greater than zero. PENDING_ACTIVATION, CLOSED, and zero-principal accounts are excluded. The PAR numerator is the outstanding principal of denominator loans whose days past due are greater than or equal to the threshold. PAR 30 uses 30, PAR 60 uses 60, and PAR 90 uses 90. ApiError.description: Error envelope. Success responses use a different shape: success, code, message, data, correlationId, and timestamp.

IndividualFinancialsRequest.description: Personal income, expenses, and employment. Use this for individual customers only.

ObligationRequest.description: An existing loan or credit obligation.

SaveLoanApplicationRequest.description: Creates or updates a loan application draft. React and Flutter send the same JSON body. On update, omit a section to leave it unchanged. Send an empty array to clear obligations, guarantors, or collaterals. Individual and SME financial sections are separate: send only the section that matches the customer.

customerId.description: Required when staff originate an application. Customers omit this and apply as themselves.

productId.description: Active loan product. Required when creating a draft. It cannot be changed later.

repaymentFrequency.description: DAILY, WEEKLY, or MONTHLY. Must match the product.

SmeFinancialsRequest.description: Business turnover, operating expenses, cash flow, liabilities, and borrowing authority. Use this for SME customers only.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Updates the customer header. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Customers can change their own contact details. Staff can also change category, branch, status, blacklist, and risk classification.

ApprovalRequest.description: Approval step required before a loan on this product can be booked.

CommercialTermsRequest.description: Commercial terms stored on one loan product version. A later version does not change an earlier one.

DocumentRequest.description: Document a customer must supply for this product.

EligibilityRequest.description: Eligibility condition evaluated before a loan is offered.

FeeRequest.description: Processing or management fee. Use amount for FLAT_AMOUNT and rate for PERCENTAGE.

LoanProductResponse.description: Loan product and the version currently in force, plus any unpublished version.

LoanProductVersionResponse.description: One immutable product version once it leaves draft, including fees, documents, and rules.

AcceptOfferRequest.description: Records that the customer read this agreement version and that their KYC identity is verified. agreementRead must be true. This request is an electronic acceptance, not a qualified digital signature.

expectedChecksum.description: Optional SHA-256 the customer saw. It must match the stored agreement checksum.

GenerateOfferRequest.description: Optional commercial overrides. The interest rate, method, tenure, and fees come from the approved product version.

principal.description: Principal to offer. Defaults to the approved amount and cannot exceed it.

disbursementDate.description: Schedule start date. Defaults to the current UTC date.

expiresOn.description: Last calendar date the offer can be accepted. Defaults to the configured expiry.

issue.description: When false, the offer stays in DRAFT. Defaults to true and issues the offer.

CreateCustomerRequest.description: Creates an individual or SME customer. Web and mobile clients use this same JSON body.

mfaRequired.description: When true, submit mfaToken and the authenticator code to the staff MFA endpoint before using the API

CreateLoanProductRequest.description: Creates a draft loan product and its first version.

productCode.description: Permanent unique code. Uppercase letters, digits, and underscores.

category.description: PERSONAL, SALARY_ADVANCE, EMERGENCY, MICROENTERPRISE, SME_WORKING_CAPITAL, BUSINESS_EXPANSION, INVENTORY_FINANCING, ASSET_FINANCING, AGRICULTURAL, SECURED, or UNSECURED

CreateLoanProductVersionRequest.description: Opens the next draft version. The current active version stays in force for existing and new loans until this version is activated.

ProductActionRequest.description: Optional note and effective date for a product lifecycle action.

effectiveFrom.description: When the version becomes available. Defaults to the current time. Used by activation.

status.description: Target status. Customer-controlled statuses SUBMITTED, WITHDRAWN, and OFFER_ACCEPTED are not accepted here.

reason.description: Required when returning for correction, referring, holding, rejecting, cancelling, or expiring an application.

LoanProductSummaryResponse.description: Catalogue row for a loan product.

CalculatorConfigResponse.description: Commercial inputs a calculator needs for the product version currently offered to customers.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token issued by the customer or staff login endpoints.

opsBasic.description: Operational account used for protected actuator endpoints.
